name: Columbia
editorial_article:
Columbia Records is widely recognized as the oldest surviving brand in the history of the recorded sound industry, tracing its origins back to the Columbia Phonograph Company founded in Washington, D.C., in 1889. For over 135 years, the label has played a foundational role in the evolution of music, from the early days of cylinder recordings and phonograph sales to the development of the 33 1/3 RPM long-playing (LP) record, which revolutionized the industry in the mid-20th century. Originally founded by Edward D. Easton and a group of investors, Columbia evolved from a local distributor of Edison technology into a global powerhouse, navigating various corporate iterations and ownership structures throughout the 20th century.

Throughout its history, Columbia has been the home of some of the most influential figures in music, fostering genres spanning jazz, classical, folk, rock, and pop. Its catalog serves as a cornerstone of the American cultural archive, preserving everything from seminal opera recordings of the early 1900s to the era-defining rock and folk works of artists like Bob Dylan and Simon & Garfunkel. Since 1991, Columbia has operated as a flagship label under Sony Music Entertainment, continuing its legacy as a major force in the global music industry. Its enduring presence and ability to adapt to shifting technological landscapes—from cylinders to streaming—have solidified its position as one of the most significant institutions in the history of recorded audio. The label's "Magic Notes" logo remains one of the most recognizable symbols in music history, reflecting a century-plus commitment to capturing and disseminating the world's most enduring sound recordings.
editorial_description: The oldest surviving record label in the world, Columbia Records has defined the trajectory of the music industry for over a century, from the birth of the phonograph to the digital age. It remains a flagship division of Sony Music Entertainment, housing a vast and culturally vital catalog of essential recordings across every major musical genre.
